source.note: re-baked from the material renderer; water layer retained from the 16px bake
source.retileMethod: crop of the existing decoded raster, not a second render_material_map.py call

sharpen.method: PIL UnsharpMask on the base layer and landmark RGB

source.mountainNativeDetailSampling: 32 TPC periodic non-mirrored source with a narrow irregular torus blend at source edges; no motifs or procedural facet/seam/foot modulation

rebuiltUnderpaint.source: final pre-water base downsampled LANCZOS 32px/cell to active 6px/cell plate

source.forestR9AlphaRule: single direct nearest-neighbor final-scale sample; alpha >= 128 becomes opaque; no filter
source.act1TerrainUnionA1OWScope: water only inside semantic bounds [16,218,163,399]; mountain remains analytic outside and in the 40-cell bake padding

build83PaintCorrection.groundPolicy: Globally phased existing R4 material renderer with legacy trees and rock motifs disabled; repaint exposed owner-meadow ground only; preserve route, forest, water, mountain, and landmark layers.
build83PaintCorrection.northPlacementPolicy: 5 reviewed main formations plus 4 reviewed rear formations; whole source crops, fixed 0.5 normalization, >=128 alpha; full formations remain unclipped.

collision.composition: QOK bits are the union of unchanged globally sorted forest+cliff raised-art alpha and the four connected companion-B north-support alpha pixels clipped to authored map bounds; no prior bit removal and no dilation

waterTreatment.semanticMask: R4 _weights("water") floored to 1.0 on exact smoothed semantic W tokens; 32ppc output
waterTreatment.phase: global world-cell origin; 96 texture texels per cell

northSupport.anchor: north edge of manifest chunk row y=0
northSupport.depth: above-plate pixels use the north overhang layer; in-map B110 pixels use the shared contactY foreground compositor

prefixMask.terrainRow: owner terrain row 0, only M cells
prefixMask.contact: first nonzero cliff alpha from existing cliff chunks or these four connected support pixels

northEnclosedWaterGapMask.seed: four-neighbor adjacency to preserved north prefix cut
northEnclosedWaterGapMask.ownerTerrainClass: M at each candidate pixel world row

northSeaBackingMask.exteriorSea: exact semantic W connected to north, west, or east map edge
northSeaBackingMask.frontageRule: north-recipe/support contributor or legacy cliff authored at northern semantic bound
northSeaBackingMask.skylineRule: first real in-map visible-or-support alpha per column; candidate pixels are strictly north of it
northSeaBackingMask.searchDomain: complete authored semantic bounds; no band cutoff or missing-alpha sentinel

fringeContact.rule: single horizontal pass from original accepted north-sea pixels through clear exact-M to first opaque authored contact; no reseeding or new rows

northSeaBackingMask.semanticProjection: exact RGB tokens replicated 2x2 with nearest semantics to 32px/cell

forwardTerrainProfile.groundPolicy: single R4 material field; reclassify only nonwater owner F/M ground cells as meadow before world-anchored material composition; preserve the existing effective route factor and all water cells
forwardTerrainProfile.raisedArtPolicy: 2061 current forest records + current cliffs classified against the pinned north XYXY rectangle; omit 25 fully-contained old objects, retain 6 crossers and 163 disjoint objects whole + nine approved whole north objects + exact 11 pilot seeds and accepted 40-record whole-crown boundary recipe; hard-cut display alpha128; shared contactY/source-origin sort; restore only four source-connected companion-B upper segments aligned to unchanged approved lower pixels
forwardTerrainProfile.collisionAuthority: QOKF8COL union of unchanged final visible forest+cliff alpha and only in-map hard-cut alpha from the four connected companion-B north supports; no prior bit removals or dilation

acceptedNaturalResidual.classification: three disconnected single-row exposed F/M pinholes (2, 1, and 3 pixels); not a continuous wedge; retained unfilled for visual/native collision review

groundBaked.note: chunks/base holds base+water+foam+forest composited; forest/ is kept for manifest validation only and is not streamed. Crest frames are masked by forest alpha.
